def solve(g, bg=0, border=3):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find bounding box of non-bg
    rows=[i for i in range(H) if any(x!=bg for x in g[i])]
    cols=[j for j in range(W) if any(g[i][j]!=bg for i in range(H))]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    cur=border+1 if border==3 else 2
    h,w=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    while True:
        if h<=2 and w<=2: break
        # ring: outline of current box, colored cur
        for i in range(r0,r1+1):
            for j in (c0,c1):
                if out[i][j]==bg: out[i][j]=cur
        for j in range(c0,c1+1):
            for i in (r0,r1):
                if out[i][j]==bg: out[i][j]=cur
        r0+=1; c0+=1; r1-=1; c1-=1
        if r0>r1 or c0>c1: break
        cur=(cur+1)%10 if cur%2==0 else cur-1
        # careful with colors used: use sequence 4,2,4,2...
    return out

from collections import deque
def solve(g):
    Hh,Ww=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]; seen=[[False]*Ww for _ in range(Hh)]; q=deque()
    for i in range(Hh):
        for j in range(Ww):
            if (i in(0,Hh-1) or j in(0,Ww-1)) and g[i][j]==0:
                seen[i][j]=True; q.append((i,j))
    while q:
        a,b=q.popleft()
        for di_,dj_ in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            n,m=a+di_,b+dj_
            if 0<=n<Hh and 0<=m<Ww and not seen[n][m] and g[n][m]==0:
                seen[n][m]=True; q.append((n,m))
    enc=[(i,j) for i in range(Hh) for j in range(Ww) if not seen[i][j]]
    rs=[i for i,_ in enc]; cs=[j for _,j in enc]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    k=4
    while True:
        if r1-r0<=1 and c1-c0<=1: break
        # paint ring of box (outline only, leave existing non-bg)
        ring=[(i,j) for i in range(r0,r1+1) for j in range(c0,c1+1)

        k=(k^2)+ (k%2)*(-2)  # just placeholder
        if r1-r0<=1 or c1-c0<=1: break
        k=2 if k==4 else 4
    return out

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[r[:] for r in g]
    cs=[(a,b) for a in range(H) for b in range(W) if g[a][b]==3]
    r0=min(a for a,_ in cs); r1=max(a for a,_ in cs); c0=min(b for _,b in cs); c1=max(b for _,b in cs)
    inn=[p for p in cs if r0<p[0]<r1 and c0<p[1]<c1]
    for i in range(r0+1,r1):
        for j in range(c0+1,c1):
            if g[i][j]!=0: continue
            if inn:
                a=inn[0]
                d=max(abs(i-a[0]),abs(j-a[1]))
                out[i][j]= 2 if d%2==0 else 4
            else:
                d=min(max(abs(i-b),abs(j-c)) for b,c in cs)-1
                out[i][j]= 4 if d%2==0 else 2
    return out
